currentCapabilityOutcomes.outcome: Request cancellation of an authorized Media job and report whether the request, stop, or final cancellation is confirmed.
constraints: A cancellation request is not cancellation confirmation.
The job remains nonterminal or finality-unknown until authoritative evidence confirms that every effect able to mutate the job has stopped.
A racing success or partial result is reconciled and preserved; immutable completed outputs are not erased.
Canceling a local watcher is not a remote cancellation request.

currentRequirementCases.given: A declared leaf, authorized input, and a binding that satisfies the requested profile and policy.

currentRequirementCases.given: A job is accepted, a caller is watching it, and a cancel or retry is requested while outcome certainty is pending.
currentRequirementCases.when: The watcher detaches or is interrupted, then an authorized caller performs the explicit cancel/reconcile/retry operation.
currentRequirementCases.then: Detaching or interrupting observation changes no job state; a cancellation request or acknowledgement is not terminal cancellation, which requires authoritative confirmation that the job's effects have stopped. For parent cancellation, stop admitting or dispatching new child work and request cancellation of active children; keep the parent pending or UNKNOWN until authoritative evidence resolves each child's effect outcome. Any partial result is explicitly labeled and bounded to its evidenced scope, never represented as full success. Keep the outcome UNKNOWN until exact authorized reconciliation resolves it, and reconcile under the same job identity before any new attempt is allowed.

currentRequirementCases.given: An authorized operator identifies an exact accessible folder or bounded input set, one admitted provider, machine, checkpoint/license, operation/profile, applicable rights and resource policy, and a versioned watch-folder, recurrence, or batch trigger configuration.
